settings.label: Sign In on YouTube
settings.description: Open the sign-in screen: an 8-char code appears there; type it at the shown URL on any device. Grants account subscriptions, history and watch-later. The code stays on screen until you approve it or press BACK (which cancels); once signed in, the same screen offers sign-out.
